about.description: What AdvocateID is and how listings work.
about.how.1: Choose a district and a practice area, court or location.
about.how.2: Compare up to three pages and read their plain facts.
about.how.3: Use Connect to start a WhatsApp conversation with a page.
about.how.title: How it works
about.p1: AdvocateID is a directory of advocates and law firms in India, organised by courts, locations and practice areas.
about.p2: Court pages carry updates with source links. Advocates and firms publish plain facts about where they practise.
about.rules.body: Under the Bar Council of India Rules, advocates may not solicit work or advertise. Pages here show only permitted information such as name, enrolment number, qualifications and areas of practice. There are no ratings, reviews or fee listings.
